item.title: Meduza: Serbian regulators shut down the go-to bank for Russian exiles, costing many their life savings
item.description: Many Russian emigrants in Serbia lost all their savings after Alta Bank’s license was revoked on October 31. Some had been keeping money in the bank to buy property, others had planned to spend their savings on a vacation, and still others now find themselves unable to run their businesses. According to a map compiled by the human rights group Kovcheg (The Ark), more than 100 Russian entrepreneurs used Alta. item.title: Meduza: What we know about Michał Oksiński, the gunman behind the Kraków mass shooting
item.description: On November 7, Michał Oksiński, a 24-year-old Polish man, shot and killed his parents and sister, then opened fire on passersby in central Kraków. Six people were killed and 15 were injured. Police shot and wounded Oksiński, who later died at a hospital. Polish authorities have called the attack an act of terrorism, but the gunman’s motive remains unclear. Oksiński left no note or manifesto explaining why he carried out one of the deadliest mass killings in Poland’s modern history. Here’s what…
